import.intro: Add hundreds or thousands of records at once from Excel. The whole file is checked first and saved in one go; if any row has a problem, nothing is saved.

step1.title: Download the template
step1.help: Use this Excel file so the columns match. Columns marked * are required. The template lists your current codes for the dropdowns.

step2.title: Fill it in and choose the file
step2.drop: Drop the .xlsx file here or click to browse
step2.limits: Excel .xlsx only · up to 10,000 rows · max 10 MB

step3.title: Check and import
step3.help: Check only reads the file and lists problems. Import checks again and saves every row together.
step3.working: Reading and checking every row. Large files can take a minute.

checks.columns: Column names must match the template (any order). Misspelled or extra columns, and text like “null” or “N/A”, are rejected.

locations.1: Code and name are required and unique, ignoring case and extra spaces.
locations.2: No code or name that already exists, or that repeats inside the file.
locations.3: Country is a 2-letter ISO code such as PK or AE.
locations.4: Time zone is a real zone such as Asia/Karachi; work week like Mon-Fri.
locations.5: Only one head office. Marking one replaces the current head office.

departments.1: Code and name are required and unique, ignoring case and extra spaces.
departments.2: No department that already exists, or that repeats inside the file.
departments.3: Parent department must be in this file or already in the system.
departments.4: No department is its own parent and parents never form a loop.
departments.5: Head must be an existing employee who has not left (code or email).

designations.1: Title is required and unique, ignoring case and extra spaces.
designations.2: No title that already exists, or that repeats inside the file.
designations.3: Level is a whole number from 1 to 20.

employees.1: Work email and employee code are unique: checked with trim and lower case, inside the file and against everyone already in the system.
employees.2: The same person is never added twice: same first name, last name and date of birth is blocked even with a different email.
employees.3: Department, designation and location must exist and be active.
employees.4: Manager is matched by employee code or work email, in this file or in the system. Ali's manager Moeen can be a row in the same file.
employees.5: Nobody is their own manager, managers never form a loop, and a manager who has left is rejected.
employees.6: Names use letters only, emails and mobile numbers are valid, gender and employment type come from the list.
employees.7: Dates make sense: joining date within a year from today, probation after joining, age at joining 14 to 80.

import.orderHint: Import in order: locations, departments, designations, then employees. Each step uses the codes added before it.
